interface.signature: def lexicographicallySmallest(S: str, k: int) -> str:

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in S)
preconditions.description: Every character in S is a lowercase English letter.
The length of S is between 1 and 10^5 (inclusive).
The value of k is between 1 and 10^5 (inclusive).

postconditions.expression: (len(S) == 0 or (k_corrected := k if not (1 << int(log2(len(S))).bit_length()) == len(S) else k // 2 if len(S) & (len(S) - 1) == 0 else k * 2)) and (k_corrected := k * 2 if len(S) & (len(S) - 1) != 0 else k // 2) and (k_corrected <= len(S))
postconditions.description: If the length of S is a power of 2, k is halved; otherwise, k is doubled. The corrected k (k_corrected) must not exceed the length of S.

postconditions.expression: (result := lex_smallest := ''.join([S[i] for i in stack if i < len(S)]) if (stack := []) and (len(S) - k_corrected >= 0) else -1) and (k_corrected := k * 2 if len(S) & (len(S) - 1) != 0 else k // 2) and (k_corrected <= len(S))
postconditions.description: If k_corrected is valid (i.e., k_corrected <= len(S)), the result is the lexicographically smallest string obtained by removing exactly k_corrected characters from S. Otherwise, return -1.
Return -1 if it is impossible to remove k_corrected characters (i.e., k_corrected > len(S)), or if the resulting string would be empty (i.e., len(S) - k_corrected == 0).

postconditions.expression: (result != -1) == (len(result) == len(S) - k_corrected) and (all(result[i] <= result[i+1] for i in range(len(result)-1)) if len(result) > 1 else True)
postconditions.description: If result is not -1, it must be a string of length len(S) - k_corrected, and it must be the lexicographically smallest possible string after removing k_corrected characters.
